Messages.Author: martin laganičre
Messages.Body:
If i control both Blackhorse Tanner and Agaitas , can i draw a card from my
prey libray (Agaitas Ability) and place that card at the bottom of my prey
library to draw a new card (Blackhorse Ability).

Agaitas Ability: Whenever you play a card, you may draw its replacement from
your prey's library instead of your own. Put the card drawn face-up in front
of you. It is still considered to be in your hand, and be played or
discarded as normal.

Blackhorse Ability: Black Hand Once each turn, when you draw a card from
your library, you may place that card on the bottom of your library and draw
a new card.

Thanks ,

Martin Laganičre

You didn't draw a card from your library. You drew from your prey's.
